title: What Is a Layer 2? How Crypto Gets Cheaper and Faster (Beginner Guide)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. A Layer 2 handles transactions off the main chain, then posts a summary back to it. Sources: CoinDesk, The Block. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: WHY IS ETHEREUM SO BUSY?
scenes.narration: Why can using a blockchain get slow and costly when many people use it at once? Layer twos try to fix that.

scenes.head: THE MAIN CHAIN
scenes.narration: A base chain, called layer one, has limited space. When lots of people want in, fees can rise.

scenes.head: WHAT IS A LAYER 2?
items: Handles work off the main chain
scenes.narration: A layer two is a separate network built on top of the main chain. It does the busy work, and leans on the main chain for security.

scenes.head: HOW ROLLUPS WORK
items: Post it to the main chain
scenes.narration: A popular type, called a rollup, bundles hundreds of transactions together and posts one compressed batch back to the main chain.

scenes.head: THE BENEFIT
scenes.narration: Sharing the cost across many users can mean lower fees and faster activity, according to CoinDesk and The Block.

scenes.head: THE TRADE-OFFS
scenes.narration: There are trade-offs. The technology is still young, and bridges that move funds between networks add risk.
